payload.purpose_context: Mission 1 of two: original behavior and original file formats first, with manual-backed coverage and original-application evidence. Mission 2 adds PDF export and selected modern conveniences only after parity acceptance.
payload.purpose_tldr: Reimplement the complete WordPerfect 5.1 DOS application faithfully on Linux.

payload.question: Should Wordling first reach complete WP 5.1 DOS parity, then add PDF export and selected modern conveniences, preserving original formats permanently?

payload.final_answer: Reach complete WordPerfect 5.1 DOS parity in M1, then add PDF export and selected modern conveniences in M2; preserve original native and companion formats in both missions.
payload.rationale: Lynn proposed the two-mission split, confirmed WP 5.1 and permanent file-format fidelity, and explicitly instructed creation of this charter and parity mission. Recorded from the existing conversation; no new answer inferred.

payload.question: Which plain WP 5.1 DOS maintenance release should be the primary documentary/reference target?

payload.final_answer: Select plain WordPerfect 5.1 for DOS, US English, dated 1992-03-09 as the primary documentary target; acquisition, installation/resource fingerprinting and observed verification remain pending.
payload.rationale: The user authorized identification of the best reference release. ADR 0001 compares candidates using publisher maintenance notes and the edition chronology. This is an agent engineering selection, not an owner-approved exclusion of other original language or compatibility obligations.
